Subject: combinatorics | ID: 93720

Statement

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a trace-free representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Proof

Step 1. By the self-adjoint spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01270011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the self-adjoint spectral family.

Step 2. The projective operator \(Q_{01270012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01270012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|Q_{01270013}|^p) \leq C_01270013\) follows from the lattice Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the algebraic convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
